title: fix(pm): the queue guard refuses a same-head PASS record that names an open must-fix or should-fix
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XLnqJDfSWuHodQt1yWeTRqD)_

Fixes #33604

domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pJkb8Rbcrj6yEXfiA

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:合并队列守卫对 Tier S 的复核记录多读三件事:记录虽写 PASS 但同时列着未结的 must-fix 或 should-fix,不放行;记录别处(任一标题、小写/列表/表格/标题里的 verdict 行、单独一行 FAIL)写着 FAIL,不放行;题头之上的 `VERDICT:` 行也计数。同一 head 上后一条把它们关掉的 delta 记录才放行(引用前一条记录的等级、写明 closed 的不算未结)。规则文字的一句(contract-review.md ①)由 #33731 带,本 PR 不碰该文件。
- **为什么改**:规则说 should-fix 要先做 delta 复核再落地,守卫却只认 PASS 这个词,带着未结 should-fix 的 PASS 记录能直接入队(卡 #33604,加上 #33687 复核记录 6890532571 的 N2、N3)。
- **风险与回滚**:只收紧放行面,不放宽:原来清不了的照样清不了。读不懂的等级一律不放行(fail closed),复核者要按 `S1 (should-fix)` 或 `No must-fix, no should-fix.` 的写法落记录,简报模板已同步写明。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `contractReviewRecordReading`(唯一读法);`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` 的 `recordPassVerdict`;`record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `BRIEF_GRADE_LINES`(教复核者的写法)。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test`,预期三个全绿(526 / 5268 / 389 例)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(非受管面)。

## What changes

1. **One reader, `contractReviewRecordReading`** (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, beside `contractReviewVerdictLines`, on the same regexes; ⛔ no second parser). For a comment with a `## Contract review` heading it returns:
   - `verdicts`: every explicit `VERDICT:` line's word, over the WHOLE comment (N3: lines above the heading count). `contractReviewVerdictLines` is now a view of this.
   - `failSpellings`: lines that read FAIL outside the explicit form (N2), in every verdict-bearing shape measured: a caps FAIL anywhere in any `## Contract review` heading's tail; a `verdict` key in any case under a heading mark, quote, bullet or emphasis, after up to two words (`Overall verdict:`), with a parenthetical (`Verdict (delta):`), with `:`, a dash, `=` or `is`, reading FAIL, FAILED or FAILS; a table row with a verdict cell and a FAIL cell in either order; a bare `FAIL` line followed only by a separator, a full stop or `!`. Prose that merely mentions FAIL (`- Newest FAIL over an older PASS`, `FAIL, none or two refuse`) is not one.
   - `findings`: per mention of the hyphenated grade word: `open` (named with its grade at the line's lead: `**S1 (should-fix) — …**`, `- **S2 (should-fix) — …**`, `M1 (must-fix, …)`, `- should-fix: …`); `closed` (a named finding whose line goes on to say closed and ENDS there: only closing emphasis, `.`, `;` or `on this head` / `at this head` / `here` may follow, and a full stop that closes the bold title may lead a new sentence: `- **S1 (should-fix): closed.**`); `none` (`must-fix: none`, same terms); a title that merely opens with either word (`closed in part`, `Closed PRs …`, `none of …`) stays OPEN; `cited` (inside `(record ID: …)`, the measured delta preamble); negated (`No must-fix, no should-fix.`, `No new should-fix.`, `Neither must-fix nor should-fix.`, `0 must-fix`, a second grade carried by `or` or `/`; after a comma or `and` the second grade needs its own `no`); or `unreadable` (any other mention, e.g. `Two should-fix, both …` or `No must-fix, should-fix S1 and S2 below.`).
2. **The guard decides** (`recordPassVerdict`, every Tier S leg including the low-risk arm): after the existing one-PASS-line rule, a record also refuses (`not-pass`, naming the comment id) when it carries a FAIL spelling, names an open must-fix or should-fix, has an unattributable grade, or its reading lacks the grade fields (fail closed). The recogniser loader now requires `reading` (re-exported by `record-recognisers.mjs`) in place of `verdictLines`. A later same-head delta record that cites the prior record's grades, names what it closes (`S1: closed`, `S1 (should-fix): closed`) and raises nothing new clears, because the locator already reads the newest same-head record. The unattributable refusal names the shapes the reader takes; it never asks for a sentence the record may already carry.
3. **The brief teaches the grammar** (`record-recognisers.mjs` `BRIEF_GRADE_LINES`, +3 lines): spell a finding `S1 (should-fix) — …`, a clean round `No must-fix, no should-fix.`, and close by id alone.

## Acceptance notes

- **Round 3 (review 6892305129, S1 and N2).** S1: the round-2 closed/none reading took the first word after the grade, so `S1 (should-fix): closed in part, still open for X`, `**S2 (should-fix) — Closed PRs are still read as merged…**`, `- **S2 (should-fix) — none of the three ablations ran…**`, `S1 (should-fix) — closed on the prior head, reopened by this delta` and `- should-fix: none of S1, S2 is fixed` cleared; the state word must now end the finding, and each of those six refuses again (pinned, with a control that `closed here.`, a closed bold title followed by a sentence, and `closed;` still clear). N2 (cheap ones taken): `Verdict: FAILED`, `Verdict is FAIL`, `Verdict (delta): FAIL`, `| FAIL | Verdict |`, `FAIL!` and a late FAIL in a heading tail (`— PASS withdrawn, FAIL`) now refuse. Not taken: a verdict column carried by a header row (needs table state). Accepted nits N1, N3, N4 unchanged; N3's `- Leg verdict: fail-closed …` refusal stands (fail closed).
- **Round 2 (review 6891926185, S1 and S2).** S1: the clean delta 6891542450 (#33711's final record, nits only) was refused for its preamble `(record 6891274033: PASS, should-fix S3, nits N7 and N8)`; citations, named-and-closed lines and `No new should-fix.` now read clean, pinned on the measured preamble. S2: `### VERDICT: FAIL`, `## Verdict: FAIL`, `| Verdict | FAIL |`, `Overall verdict: FAIL`, `Verdict — FAIL`, `FAIL.` and `**FAIL.**` now refuse beside one PASS line, and `No must-fix, should-fix S1 and S2 below.` is unreadable (fail closed), one pin each. Nits taken: N1 (`Neither … nor`, `0 must-fix`, `must-fix: none`, `- should-fix: none` read clean), N3 (every heading's tail is read). Not taken: N2 (the grade is read off the hyphenated word only; the brief spells it and every measured record uses it), N4 (a prose bullet opening `- FAIL — …` refuses; fail closed, a repost cures it).
- **Grammar measured, not assumed.** Read on the real records of PRs #33686 (6890432656), #33687 (6890532571), #33688 (6890622635 round 1, 6890939010 delta) and #33711 (6890932729) with the new reader, plus the review's own measurement of #33711's deltas 6891274033 and 6891542450, #33720 (6891083453) and #33726 (6891576194):
  - #33686, #33687: one PASS, no FAIL spelling, no open grade, nothing unreadable → still clear.
  - #33688 round 1: S1, S2 should-fix open → refused (correct: they earned a delta).
  - #33688 delta 6890939010: S1, S2, N1 closed (`- **S1: closed.**`, no grade word), but it raises **S3 (should-fix, the seat's, no head change)** on the PR body → refused. If #33688 is still queued when this lands, it needs a later same-head record closing S3.
  - #33711 round 1: S1, S2 should-fix open plus the count line `No must-fix. Two should-fix, both …` (unreadable) → refused; delta 6891274033 raises S3 → refused; delta 6891542450 (cites the prior grades, closes S3, `No must-fix. No should-fix.`) → clears.
  - #33720, #33726: nits only → clear.
- **Rule sentence owed, carried by PR #33731.** The seat moved `contract-review.md` to #33718 (PR #33731) mid-round, so this PR leaves it untouched. The sentence the rule owes, measured to fit line 51 in place (63/63 lines, 119/120 bytes, paid by dropping 「两条」 and the second 「Tier」): `- 请审/求批与落地前检,过则 Tier S 入队、H 等人批:① 现 head 同形达档 PASS 在案,无前两级。` (前两级 = must-fix/should-fix, the term line 45 already uses). `check-skill-line-ratchet` was green with it on an earlier head (148b0ce6, dropped).
- **Fail closed costs a wording rule.** A record that quotes the grade word in prose (`the should-fix rule says …`) is refused as unreadable. The brief now names the two shapes the reader accepts; a seat can always repost a clean record.
- **Not changed:** the H43 patrol (`contractReviewVerdictOf`, first match under the heading) and `check-owed-reviews.mjs` still read no grades; that is follow-up F1 of record 6890532571, not this card.
- Ablation, round 3 (on 38cc292a, guard self-test, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty): the state-word tail reverted to `(closed|none)\b` → the r3 titled-open row red (all six CLEARED); the heading-tail caps FAIL deleted → the r3 N2 row red.
- Ablation, round 2 (each reader branch mutated on 7c2fb525, guard self-test run, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty): citation off → the measured-delta row red; closed/none state off → 2 rows red; table-cell regex off → the S2 FAIL-forms row red; comma carrying the denial → the S2 comma row red.
- Ablation, round 1 (each guard branch mutated with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, run, restored; `git diff HEAD` empty after each): open-grade branch off → 3 #33604 rows red; FAIL-spelling branch off → 2 N2 rows red; unattributable branch off → 1 row red; reading below the heading only → the N3 row red.

## Verification

- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived model mandate (floor sonnet, default opus); built on the claim's default.
- `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-78jrbs`: **NOT governed** (0 of 3 paths on the register; `scripts/pm/**` is not a row); 190 changed lines, under 3000. Ordinary queue landing.
- Self-tests on the final head 38cc292a: `check-governed-queue-guard --self-test` 526 pass; `check-half-states --self-test` 5268 pass (11 new H43 rows); `record-recognisers --self-test` 389 pass (1 new cross-tool pin: the brief's shapes are the guard's).
